title: A budgeted target is shown whole or omitted, never replaced with a misleading prefix
query: 源记录的保存期限与访问条件是什么？

sources.content: 旧来源含有完整条件和末尾否定。

entries.content: 重复的背景只说明记录位置，不增设新规则。
entries.suffix: 最终限制：仅演练内网，禁止公网；日志保留30天。

expected.tail_fact: 最终限制：仅演练内网，禁止公网；日志保留30天。

semantic_review: The authored target tail contains the meaningful constraint. Pure regression binds the complete body and tail in the confirmation fingerprint; it does not execute the service budget-packing loop. Whole-or-omitted packing and response bounds need separate service/integration evidence, and do not certify model comprehension or overall recall completeness.
